description: This file defines data models and enums for a memory match card game API, including request and response schemas, game state representations, and game configuration options.

classes.name: BoardSize
classes.description: Enumeration of supported board sizes for the memory game.

classes.name: NewGameRequest
classes.description: Request payload to create a new memory game session.

classes.name: FlipCardRequest
classes.description: Request payload to flip a card at a given index within a session.

classes.name: CardView
classes.description: Readonly view representation of a single card for clients.

classes.name: GameSessionView
classes.description: Client-facing representation of the game session state.

methods.name: to_card_count
methods.description: Static method returning total number of cards for a given board size.

methods.name: coerce_size
methods.description: Class method to coerce string aliases into supported BoardSize values.
